name: manual_fcf6fe
claim: A GitHub PR's --base must name a branch that exists on the base/target repo, never a fork-only branch -- gh pr create --base <fork-only-branch> against an upstream repo fails with 'Base ref must be a branch' or 'No commits between'; for a family of PRs meant to stack across a fork boundary, base every PR on the upstream default branch (e.g. master) and communicate the dependency in prose (PR body or comments), not via GitHub's native base-branch stacking.

decisions.notes: Hit opening two dependent PRs for agentic-stack against its upstream repo: attempting --base on a branch that only existed on the contributor's fork failed outright; fixed by using --base master for both and stating the dependency explicitly in each PR's body.
